comment: Username rules, read by the game (services/usernames.gd) and the server (backend/src/usernames.ts); both test suites check game/tests/fixtures/display_names/username_vectors.json. A username is 3 to 18 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -, starts and ends with a letter or digit and never has two symbols in a row. The block list (display_name_blocklist.json) applies too. A name is reserved when its fold (lowercase, symbols removed, trailing digits removed) is one of reserved, when its symbol-free lowercase holds one of reserved_inside, or when it starts with one of type_prefixes followed by a symbol. A reserved name that is also a CONFIG friend alias may be taken by that alias's player only.
